text:
Elaine: quick sync — i put together a small proposal to ship an "api toggle" for chat that lets callers pick a behavior: messages-first (current plan) OR prompt-fallback (compact prompt mode). customer asks are driving this. short thread to align on rollout gating and telemetry

Noah: curious — why per-call toggle instead of per-route config?

Elaine: two reasons: 1) customer use cases vary per request (agent vs simple chat) and 2) gives us ability to roll experiments without deprecating existing routes. per-route is still on the table for enterprise defaults.

Maria: sounds OK. we need to define exact semantics — e.g., when prompt-fallback is enabled do we remove roles entirely, or map roles -> annotations?

Riyad: technical constraints: prompt-fallback reduces token count but breaks structured tool-calling bindings unless we include an explicit role mapping header. otherwise we can't reconstruct which messages were system vs assistant.

Noah: suggestion: keep roles in metadata but allow server to convert to compact prompt for the model. SDKs can set: 
```
{
  "chat_mode": "compact_prompt",
  "role_preserve": "meta"  // values: none|meta|inline
}
```

Elaine: good call. launch gating: must have
- client SDK support (py/ts)
- telemetry for token delta + quality regressions
- rollback path (auto-fallback to messages)
- clear migration guide for customers

Maria: for quality regressions we should tie to a prompt-set eval and a small set of customer samples. propose threshold: >2% drop in BLEU/ROUGE-like metric or >3% increase in hallucination signals => block.

Riyad: +1. Also add latency SLO checks. compact_prompt should not increase p95 by >10ms in our serving infra.

Noah: instrumentation we need from runtime: 
- per-call mode tag (messages|compact)
- token_in/out delta per-mode
- model chosen + quantization profile
- fallback count (how often we auto-fall back)

deploy-bot: auto-deploy plan created: canary on 10% of hosted API keys, feature flag gated.

Elaine: rollout phases I propose: 
1) internal beta (console + SDK flags) with dev teams, 2) private customers opt-in, 3) open beta with canary %, 4) GA when evals + SLOs pass for 7 days.

Maria: decision on system role enforcement? customers asked for stronger system role guarantees in compact mode. two options: 
A) hard enforce: system content always prepended in explicit system token (increases tokens)
B) soft metadata: keep system separate and rely on server-side glue to ensure precedence

Riyad: B is nicer for tokens but riskier for mis-specified clients. recommend B for beta, A for GA if we see confusion.

Noah: SDK ergonomics: add helpers to convert messages -> compact prompt with optional review UI. Example helper: `toCompactPrompt(messages, roleMapping)`

Elaine: ask to product/design: create a simple two-slide migration doc for customers showing 1) cost benefits 2) compatibility caveats 3) tool-calling checklist.

Maria: also: add an eval harness entry for LLM QA + tool invocation correctness across both modes.

Riyad: one more: ensure routing/fallback respects Dedicated/Private customers — feature flag should be tenant-scoped and not flip for Reserved capacity without admin approval.

Elaine: action items:
- @Noah add SDK flags + helper PR (due EOW)
- @Riyad add runtime telemetry + fallback counters (due next sprint)
- @Maria create eval set and threshold definitions (due next Wed)
- @Design / @PMs: migration doc + customer comms (sync Friday)

Noah: i'll open PR and drop a short checklist in this thread.

Maria: will start the eval harness and ping when ready.

Elaine: thanks all — if nobody objects i'll post this as the proposal in the product backlog and mark it for next quarter prioritization. :white_check_mark:
